photos.desc: Photograph of a fossil cast of a Bambiraptor feinbergi skeleton taken at the North American Museum of Ancient Life.
Life restoriation of Bambiraptor ("baby plunder"), a genus of dromaeosaurid (Dinosauria, Theropoda, Coelurosauria, Maniraptora) from the Late Cretaceous of North America.
